name: Jizhi A1
summary: Jizhi A1 is IIMT’s wheeled humanoid platform for manipulation and embodied intelligence research. It pairs a mobile base with an articulated torso, two arms and dexterous hands. The manufacturer describes visual, voice and tactile sensing, open interfaces, and support for robotics software including ROS and Isaac. Intended applications include manufacturing collaboration, robotics teaching, algorithm validation and exhibit guidance. It is publicly documented; current commercial delivery availability is unverified.
